text:
1804 is a leap year (divisible by 4, not a century year).  
From 02-21 back 21 days → Feb 1.  
Remaining 145 − 21 = 124 days earlier.  
Jan has 31 days, so back 31 days → Dec 2, 1803.  
Remaining 124 − 31 = 93 days earlier.  
Count back: Nov 30 days → Oct 4, 1803.  
Remaining 93 − 30 = 63 days earlier.  
Sep 30 days → Aug 5, 1803.  
Remaining 63 − 30 = 33 days earlier.  
Jul 31 days → Jul 5, 1803.  
Remaining 33 − 31 = 2 days earlier → 1803-07-03.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1803-07-03
